title: Chapter 409: The Heavenly Demon Clan Hides Its Incompetence
content:
Chapter 409: The Heavenly Demon Clan Hides Its Incompetence

The Dragon Clan, Ao Qing’s confidant.

That was brought to the deserted city by Ao Qing in the All Spirit Realm. Since then, that part of the dragon clan has been hiding in the deserted city and has never been revealed.

Coupled with the cultivation of the massive resources in Huangcheng, this dragon clan is definitely a force that cannot be underestimated.

And just as Lu Xue and others were waiting in place, two familiar figures appeared in their eyes again.

"Huh? It's you."

The old man Broken Sword looked at the two brothers and sisters who had just left in surprise.

Lu Xue and Ao Qing also looked over.

Lu Xue's expression was dull and there was no fluctuation at all.

Ao Qing had a little disappointment in his eyes, but he didn't say anything.

Bai Xu pulled his sister to everyone, coughed lightly, his face also a little rosy, "Two seniors, I've decided. I think it's better for my sister and I to follow you."

Bai Xu sorted out his emotions and spoke confidently.

"It's too late, I don't want it."

Lu Xue said expressionlessly.

"Um?"

Bai Xu was slightly stunned. This situation was something he didn't expect, so he was stunned.

Bai Ling followed Bai Xu, lowering her head tightly.

"Oh, what have you done long ago? Opportunities are not available at any time."

Ao Qing shook his head and said.

After Bai Xu reacted at this moment, he suddenly felt very regretful. He gritted his teeth and knelt on one knee at Lu Xue, "Senior, please forgive me for your recklessness before. You have saved my life and wish you Let us brother and sister stay by your side.”

It's ironic that the brother and sister who were scrambling to grab the human race were so humble in front of Lu Xue, and even begging for taking in it.

But Lu Xue still shook her head, "You can leave now."

Bai Xu's face looked sad.

But at this time, he seemed to have thought of something, so he suddenly looked up and pulled his sister beside him to Lu Xue.

"Senior, I took my sister away. You can't blame her. Please give her a chance!"

As he said that, Bai Xu signaled Bai Ling to kneel down quickly.

But Bai Ling looked at her brother with moist eyes, and she cried, "Brother, I just want to be with you."

Bai Xu was a little silent.

Of course, he couldn't bear to part with his sister, but after experiencing a separation from life and death, he had figured it out that only when he became stronger and stronger can he be qualified to talk about those things.

Now both him and Bai Ling are too weak.

Next, he will become stronger at all costs. No one can threaten his sister's life by his side.

"Senior, please accept my sister. I know you are a good person!"

Bai Xu kowtowed to Lu Xue again.

But Lu Xue frowned slightly, "Are you using my kindness to threaten me?"

Upon hearing this, Bai Xu's face changed slightly, "Senior, I didn't mean that."

Lu Xue snorted lightly, turned around and left.

The old man Broken Sword looked at the two brothers and sisters, and said nothing, but also followed Lu Xue.

In place, Bai Ling wanted to help his brother up, but Bai Xu rarely got angry with his beloved sister, "Do you know that you are already dragging me down now!"

"What's the use of you being by my side?"

These two sentences made Bai Ling pale and stood there in a daze.

"Brother, what are you talking about?"

Bai Ling couldn't believe it.

Bai Xu snorted coldly, "Don't you understand? I don't want you anymore. You have no other way out except to follow them."

Bai Ling burst into tears, "Brother, you don't have to provoke me so much. I know you want me to be with those two seniors, but I just want to follow you."

Bai Ling held Bai Xu's arm tightly, but Bai Xu didn't appreciate it at all.

With a slight force, Bai Ling threw him on the ground.

"Whatever you think, anyway, you don't have to follow me anymore."

As he said that, Bai Xu stood up, pointed to the direction where Lu Xue and others left, and said, "If you run to follow you now, you may be able to catch up with them. Please beg for your own blessing."

After saying this, Bai Xu did not hesitate and rushed in the opposite direction.

However, no matter how fast he ran, sadness still caught up with him.

Tears kept flowing from the corners of my eyes, "Sister, forgive me, my brother, in this humble era of demon clan, our situation is really difficult, but don't worry, one day, I will become a strong man and lead the Heavenly Demon clan to glory, Again oppressed by any race.”

“At that time, we can be together forever.”

"I, Bai Xu, swore here!"

After Bai Ling watched her brother really leave, she seemed to have lost her soul and stood there crying.

At this moment, her sky fell.

But she couldn't just give up.

"Brother, I know you didn't mean it, but you shouldn't be so decisive."

Bai Ling looked at the direction of Bai Xu's departure, with a little blaming in his voice.

Then, she chased Lu Xue and others without hesitation.

She also wants to become stronger, and she must be stronger than her brother. In this way, she will not have to hide behind her brother in the future and can protect her brother.

......

"Miss Lu, that guy is still following."

Lu Xue and the others walked in front, and more than ten meters behind were Bai Ling.

Bai Ling did not get close to Lu Xue and the others, and just followed him far away.

Lu Xue whispered, "Don't worry about her."

At this time, Ao Qing's expression lit up, "My little master, here you are here!"

Just finished speaking.

Above the void.

Rumble!

The originally quiet sky suddenly became dark clouds, and then a huge space-time channel slowly opened.

In an instant, the entire demon mountain vibrated, and countless monsters felt some terrifying aura and lay on the ground, not daring to move at all.

Bai Ling was not that serious, but she was still pale and could only lower her head tightly.

Buzz —

The space transmission channel fluctuated.

Huge dragons gushed out from it and hovered over the sky.

"Sir Longzi, we are here!"

Below, Ao Qing stood on Lu Xue's shoulder, looking at his tribe members with excitement.

But after a moment, he angrily said, "Why are you still standing there? You can't get off yet!"

With a command, the dragons quickly turned into dragon man states, and then landed in front of Lu Xue and Ao Qing.

"We will pay homage to Miss Lu Xue and Lord Longzi!"

The dragons could distinguish between the big and small kings at this moment, and first saluted Lu Xue.

This made Ao Qing nod his head secretly. He is worthy of being a member of his tribe, and he still has some insight.

Lu Xue nodded to the dragons and then said, "If there is something wrong with the demon clan today, you will be in charge of the Heavenly Demon Clan these days."

"yes."

At the same time, due to the strong strength and numerous people of the Aoqing tribe, this aura was quickly felt by the clans of the Chaos Realm.

The clans were shocked that the Heavenly Demon Clan was actually hiding so deeply.

There is such a terrifying power.

The one who feels the deepest is the Holy Spirit Clan. It originally belonged to the strong clan of the Chaos Realm, but later, like the Heavenly Demon Clan, he finally joined the human clan.

Everyone was very miserable, but now it's better, you are still hiding your weakness.

Although your own failure is terrible, your friend's success is even more heartbreaking.
